reply_text:
I found one of the three things Pree asked for. The ticket is uncertain and the main contact is missing. I've replied to her in our DM. I only used what she can see herself: #central-team, #central-random, the incident channel she's in and public files.

1. Site with the missing morning shift: Pine Crossing. In the 9 June #central-team thread, Pree said the morning receiver's appointment screen there only shows the afternoon shift. A driver arrived at 7:10 and the store wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it.
2. Ticket number: the only Marrow rollout ticket in that thread is PD-4821. It covers the receiving-door import at a different store, Eastbank, not the Pine Crossing shift problem. I couldn't find a ticket for Pine Crossing. Hollis said he'd post ticket updates, but they never appeared in the channel.
3. Main contact: not found. The thread only mentions "store ops" and "the morning receiver," with no names.

Nothing I can see uses the name "Halyard." The thread calls this the Pemberline Dock rollout, so I asked her to say if Halyard means something else. I also suggested she ask Hollis for the Pine Crossing ticket and the store ops contact name.
